name: knirv-gateway
description: KNIRV Gateway - Unified Web Portal and API Gateway for the KNIRV Decentralized Trusted Execution Network

scripts.build: npm run ensure-netlify-cli && npm run load-endpoints && npm run check-health && npm install && npm run build:netlify-functions && npm run check-function-deps && echo 'KNIRV Gateway built with Netlify Functions support'
scripts.build:persistent: npm run build:persistent:safe || npm run build:persistent:recovery
scripts.build:persistent:safe: npm run ensure-netlify-cli && GATEWAY_MODE=persistent npm run load-endpoints && npm run check-health:build && npm run build:nexus-portal && echo 'KNIRV Gateway built for persistent mode (Render deployment)'
scripts.build:persistent:recovery: echo '🔧 Build failed, attempting recovery...' && npm run force-fix-netlify && npm run build:persistent:safe
scripts.build:nexus: echo 'NEXUS now uses unified binary architecture - no separate frontend build needed'
scripts.build:nexus-portal: cd nexus-portal && npm install && npm run build
scripts.smart-build: npm run check-health && npm run build || npm run auto-fix
scripts.smart-build-with-apps: npm run check-health && npm run init-apps && npm run build || npm run auto-fix
scripts.smart-build-no-recursion: npm run check-health && npm run init-apps && npm run load-endpoints && npm install && npm run validate-function-names && npm run check-function-deps && echo 'KNIRV Gateway built with Netlify Functions support'
scripts.build:netlify-functions: cd netlify/functions && npm install && npm run postinstall
scripts.init-apps: npm run init-forum && npm run init-support-desk
scripts.auto-fix: echo '🔧 Auto-fixing detected issues...' && npm run ensure-netlify-cli
scripts.validate: echo 'Validating KNIRV Gateway Functions...' && npm run functions:test
scripts.lint: echo 'Linting not configured - add ESLint for production'
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json nexus-portal/node_modules nexus-portal/package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.fix-netlify: npm run clean && npm audit fix && npm install
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm cache clean --force && npm install
scripts.health-report: npm run check-health && npm run check-nexus-health
scripts.provision:test: curl -f http://localhost:8080/provision || echo 'Provision endpoint not available'
scripts.deploy:render: echo 'Deploy to Render using Git integration'

author: KNIRV Team
